subject: Post-demo: Buying committee recap & next steps
messages:
From: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.com>
To: Tom Jennings <tom.jennings@acmeretail.com>, Samantha Lee <samantha.lee@acmeretail.com>
Cc: Rishi Malhotra <rishi.malhotra@redwood.com>, Priyom Das <priyom.das@redwood.com>
Date: 2026-08-15T15:00:00-07:00
Subject: Post-demo: Buying committee recap & next steps

Hi Tom + Samantha —

Thanks again for your time today. Felt like a productive demo and good alignment on the use case (chat-based customer support triage + agent assist). Quick recap and clear next steps so we can keep momentum with the buying committee: 

Summary
- Demo focused on Redwood inference runtime, latency guarantees, and integration points for your Contact Center platform.
- Key decision criteria you shared: predictable latency under 200ms p50 for short messages, data residency controls, and clear unit-cost estimates for 10M tokens/month.

Stakeholders (as discussed)
- Economic buyer: Tom Jennings (you) — responsible for final approval.
- Procurement/legal: Procurement Team (procurement@acmeretail.com) — needs vendor setup + contract redlines.
- Security: Samantha Lee — will run SOC 2 + security questionnaire.
- Platform lead: Sara Nguyen (not on thread) — implementation owner.

Open items / asks for Acme
1) Confirm buying committee date/time (you mentioned next Friday).
2) Share any procurement vendor form (vendor setup, PO cadence) so we can prep required docs.
3) Security artifacts: Samantha — can you confirm whether a brief SOC2 summary + encryption details are sufficient? We can provide SOC2 summary + DSG (see attachment).

Our proposed next steps
- Redwood to send a concise one-page pricing profile for the expected 10M token run-rate + a SOW draft for initial pilot (attached: Acme-MAP-v1.pdf, SOW-draft.docx).
- Marissa/Rishi to join the buying committee meeting and answer technical + commercial questions.
- Procurement to share vendor onboarding checklist; legal to start redline timeframe.

Attachments included: Acme-MAP-v1.pdf (map of suggested pilot), SOW-draft.docx (pilot SOW).

If that aligns, I’ll send a one-page pricing summary by tomorrow and lock in times for the committee.

Thanks,

Marissa Cole
Senior Account Executive | Redwood Inference
marissa.cole@redwood.com | (415) 555-0123

--

Thanks Marissa — appreciate the clear recap.

Two quick notes from my side:
- Yes, we’re aiming to hold the buying committee next Friday (2026-08-21) at 10:00am PT. I’ll confirm the invite once I check with Sara.
- Procurement has been looped in (included above). Procurement will need vendor setup docs and a W9. Also please flag any minimum PO requirements or billing cadence.

Samantha — for security, a short SOC2 summary + encryption-in-transit / at-rest notes would be ideal for the initial review. If you need more, we’ll schedule a deeper session with our security team.

Looking forward to the pricing one-pager.

VP, Engineering | Acme Retail

From: Priyom Das <priyom.das@redwood.com>

Cc: Neha Kapoor <neha.kapoor@redwood.com>
Date: 2026-08-16T11:02:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Post-demo: Buying committee recap & next steps

Marissa / Rishi — good thread. Short internal run-down and recommended approach before the committee: 

Account stance
- Acme is motivated (clearly want latency + cost predictability). Economic buyer engaged. Procurement process looks standard.

Commercial options to present (one-pager):
1) Pilot option (90 days): reserved capacity for pilot, usage-based overage; estimate: $Xk/month for reserved + $Y per million tokens. (Low friction, faster time-to-value)
2) Production committed option (12 months): discounted reserved capacity + SLA; includes on-call support and 30-day rollout window.

Security / legal asks
- Neha: can you lead the SOC2 summary + short answers to their questionnaire? Recommend we send a 1-page security summary + SOC2-summary.pdf.
- Rishi: if procurement asks for PO terms, we should keep standard 30/Net 45. Flag anything else we can be flexible on.

Attachments: attaching updated SOW-draft.docx with clarified pilot scope.

Action items
- Marissa: finalize the one-page pricing and send to Tom/Samantha by EOD tomorrow.
- Neha: prepare SOC2-summary.pdf and short Q&A (aim for Tuesday).
- Rishi/Priyom: prep a <5 slide deck for the buying committee highlighting latency, cost, and rollback/fallback options.

Thanks,
Priyom
Account Executive | Redwood Inference
priom.das@redwood.com

Hi Marissa / Rishi —

Thanks for the invite. Procurement here — a couple of items we need to start vendor onboarding: 

1) Vendor form: please complete and return our vendor setup form (I’ll attach a blank template to the calendar invite).
2) W9: please provide a completed W9 for Redwood (we require this before issuing a PO).
3) Insurance & SOC: a short SOC2 summary is fine for initial review; we will request full ROE if we proceed.
4) Standard terms: we typically require 60 days for contract review; if legal redlines are minimal we can compress this to 30 days.

Please upload the requested docs to the shared Drive link or send directly to procurement@acmeretail.com. Once we have the W9 and vendor form, we’ll begin onboarding and will provide a PO template.
